topics.topic: Read/access paths for authority records (especially EffectApproval): which actions expose them to owner/agent and whether they appear in run views
questions: Can approvals be inspected directly, and by which action path (inspect/read traces/run view)?
Which product action(s) expose these authority records (approvals, grants, effect attempts) to owner/agent callers, and which are internal-only?
Through which product action are EffectApproval records readable to agents (inspect runs, trace read, or a separate approval-read), and are they part of run views by default?

topics.topic: Handling of agent-initiated activation for effectful (non-read-only) flow versions: refuse immediately vs persist owner-decision request
questions: When the requested flow version is effectful (not read-only), what exactly happens if an agent (non-owner token) calls activate: immediate refusal, or creation of an in-kernel request the owner later decides?

When an agent asks to activate a proven non-read-only flow, is there a persisted activation request for later owner decision, or is the agent call simply refused/blocked until the owner performs activation directly?

topics.topic: Captured failed execution semantics: whether and when `expected_outputs` can be populated
questions: When a failed execution is captured, is `expected_outputs` always absent, or can/should it be populated from observed outputs in some failure kinds?

topics.topic: EffectAttempt sequencing rule: whether `not_sent` entries consume/increment `attempt_number`
questions: Does a `not_sent` record consume/increment `attempt_number`, or is attempt numbering only for actual sends?

topics.topic: FlowConstant type support for file inputs: file carriage allowed or value-only constants
questions: Can a flow constant ever be a file (and target a file input port), or are flow constants restricted to value carriage only?

topics.topic: MCP/API surface decision: which product actions are first-class MCP operations vs sub-modes of broader operations
questions: Which product actions are first-class MCP operations, and which are sub-modes of broader operations like `author` or `run`?

topics.topic: Rollback admission policy: require pre-existing admission verdict vs trigger fresh admission on rollback
questions: If an earlier implementation has no admission verdict over the current corpus, does rollback trigger a fresh admission run, or must such a verdict already exist before rollback is attempted?

topics.topic: StandingGrant carryover on re-activating the same flow version: auto-reuse existing active grant vs require fresh grant
questions: If that same flow version is activated again later, does its previously active (not revoked) grant automatically apply to new runs, or is a fresh grant required after each activation switch away and back?

topics.topic: StandingGrant revocation scope after activation switches: can revoke grants on previously active versions with in-flight runs
questions: After a new flow version becomes active, can the owner revoke an active grant on the previously active version (which still affects in-flight runs pinned to that old version), or are revoke actions limited to the currently active version only?
